meta.title: AT-QG Prediction Outcome Dashboard
meta.purpose: single source of truth for the external validation of the registered predictions
meta.registry_rule: No future phase may modify a registered prediction. Frozen values never change; only the state may advance forward.

outcomes.name: 106 GeV resonance
outcomes.current_evidence: No confirmed signal in the 99–114 GeV window (QG188A INCONCLUSIVE, QG199). Classic low-mass scalar excesses persist at ~95 GeV (combined γγ 3.1σ = the 91.19 rung, not P1). CMS γγ 15–73 fb and ATLAS γγ 19–102 fb limits do not exclude P1; LEP2 114.4 GeV bound is SM-coupling only.
outcomes.support_level: NONE (inside window) — no excess at 106.39 GeV; window open
outcomes.next_experiment: HL-LHC 3000 fb⁻¹ diphoton (projected 1–3 fb sensitivity in 100–106 GeV)
outcomes.falsification: No signal in statistically sensitive searches of the 99–114 GeV window (DISFAVORED/FALSIFIED)

outcomes.name: 0νββ m_ββ = 2.02 meV
outcomes.current_evidence: No experiment has reached the 2.02 meV sensitivity (current limits 0.036–0.156 eV, QG179). The prediction is below all existing 0νββ limits.
outcomes.next_experiment: nEXO / LEGEND-1000 ton-scale (0νββ half-life sensitivity ~10²⁸ yr)
outcomes.falsification: Significant exclusion below 2.02 meV (a measured upper limit < 2.02 meV FALSIFIES)

outcomes.name: Sector-ladder spectrum
outcomes.current_evidence: The 151.98 rung matches the combined CMS+ATLAS ~152 GeV diphoton excess (local 3.6σ, global up to 5.4σ, arXiv:2503.16245). Alignment MODERATE SUPPORT: 0.0132% deviation, p(any rung) = 0.26% (1 in 386), z = 2.80σ (QG201). SM anchors Z/H/t confirm the ladder scale (QG200).
outcomes.support_level: MODERATE — 151.98 rung aligns with the ~152 GeV excess (2.80σ)
outcomes.last_audit: QG200 (sector ladder evidence audit) / QG201 (statistics audit)
outcomes.next_experiment: HL-LHC diphoton confirmation of the 152 GeV excess; full Run-3 searches
outcomes.falsification: A sensitive search excludes any frozen rung (limit below the rung energy FALSIFIES)
